_note: Region Modifier catalog — §2.11.3's seventeen. Rows come from docs/design/catalogs/modifiers.md. Same `hook` + `params` vocabulary as a relic (§7.7), for the same reason Badges use it (§7.3.6): these are independent terms in the same formulas, and a second implementation of one rule is a second place for it to drift. A modifier lasts exactly one Region and never stacks with another (§2.11.3.2). Four rows ship inert because the systems they steer do not exist yet; each names the version that lands it, and `isOfferable` keeps them off the menu rather than selling a no-op.

modifiers.name: Hand of Plenty
modifiers.description: Draw one more card every turn, all Region.

modifiers.name: Swap Fuel
modifiers.description: Every manual swap heals your new Lead 5 HP.

modifiers.name: Sturdy Lead
modifiers.description: Once each fight, the first Pokémon that would faint survives at 1 HP.

modifiers.name: Type Affinity
modifiers.description: Your team's best type deals 10 % more, all Region.

modifiers.name: Trauma Resistance
modifiers.description: Each Trauma stack costs 4 % of max HP instead of 5 %.

modifiers.name: Lucky Draw
modifiers.description: Draw an extra item card on the first turn of every fight.

modifiers.name: Status Mastery
modifiers.description: The status conditions you inflict last a turn longer.

modifiers.name: Pocket Healer
modifiers.description: Winning a fight heals your whole team 5 % of its health.

modifiers.name: Coin Purse
modifiers.description: Poké Dollars come in half again as fast.

modifiers.name: Glass Cannon
modifiers.description: You deal 20 % more damage, and take 20 % more.

modifiers.name: Quick Study
modifiers.description: Every Pokémon gains 15 % more XP from a fight.

modifiers.name: Bargain Hunter
modifiers.description: The Shop and the Dojo cost you a fifth less.

modifiers.name: Iron Skin
modifiers.description: Every Pokémon takes 1 less damage from Cleave attacks.

modifiers.name: Naturalist's Lens
modifiers.description: Choose a biome; it becomes the Region's most common one.
modifiers.pending: needs a choose-a-biome step and a map re-roll after it — v0.6

modifiers.name: Pokédex Whisper
modifiers.description: The first hidden intent of each fight is revealed.
modifiers.pending: needs a first-only variant of the intent reveal — v0.6

modifiers.name: Mass Mobilization
modifiers.description: Step-Forward and Step-Backward also draw you a card.
modifiers.pending: needs a draw hook on the positional modifiers — v0.6

modifiers.name: Field Surveyor
modifiers.description: You choose the battlefield for every wild fight.
